primaryAuthority.officialFacts: LEGO identifies set 7303, 24 pieces, year 2001; page 1 contains the completed appearance on the cover and final build step.

displayedProductionTarget.view: Page 1, final completed build at step 7; shown as a close crop in the HTML review.
displayedProductionTarget.provenance: Third-party hosted scan of the official LEGO instruction page. The official LEGO PDF remains the authority and is linked in the review.

officialSources.supports: Set identity and official availability of instructions.
Official construction sequence and completed model on page 1, step 7.

secondaryCrossChecks.supports: Catalog lists both 7303 and 1415 as Jet Scooter sets in Life on Mars.
Identifies 1415 as the same Jet Scooter issued in a different package; secondary catalog evidence.
Independent completed-model image, cross-checked against the official instruction sequence.

previousComparativeReference.authority: Director-selected for comparative appearance review only; not a production target, exact piece topology approval, source color approval, or production authorization.

directlyShown: One exposed Martian rider sits on a narrow, elongated open deck.
Two long side tubes frame the central deck.
Two small translucent orange cones face forward at the nose.
Blue and gray body elements and rounded blue rear equipment remain visible above the thin deck.
inferredFromComparingViews: The instruction sequence shows the side tubes joined to the nose and rear assemblies around the central deck; preserve them as separate visible structural masses rather than enclosing them in a hull.
unresolved: The available completed view is a three-quarter view. A full rear, underside, and directly opposed left/right photo pair were not located; no left/right asymmetry is claimed.
The static model and instructions do not establish hover height, nozzle motion, propulsion cycle, or which element is a gameplay attack emitter.
adaptation: None. Keep all game motion, hover presentation, attack effects, and sockets outside this static appearance decision.
